platinum.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving — leave them off for the whole run.
platinum.saves: Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (15 slots). There is no mission replay.

steps: Play Gone Fishing and finish Chapter 1, then Chapter 2 — the first story trophies pop on their own.
After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept her balcony meditation — the one possibly missable moment in the whole game.
Start the Strangers & Freaks chains as soon as they appear, and scan vehicles and study animals with the WAiNK app and binoculars from day one.
Try one round of every activity type as you meet it, so Master of None is already ticking.
Make a manual save at the end of Chapter 2 before moving on.
stages.title: First Steps — Chapters 1–2

steps: Play through Chapters 3, 4 and 5; every story and mission trophy in this stage unlocks by finishing missions.
Finish the final mission of each Stranger — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — as soon as their chains open, because quest givers go quiet for stretches of the story.
Hunt Bret's unique animal and complete eight Stranger strands before the finale, when the chains close.
Do the partner robberies, Combat Focus kills, the VCIA plane steal and the Rhino tank while the story throws those moments at you.
Keep a manual save at the end of Chapter 4 and another right before the final mission.
stages.title: The Story Deepens — Chapters 3–5

steps: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist in order: robberies first, then collectibles, then activities.
Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges and win the drone races and unique races — the race and range medals feed both trophies and the checklist.
Clear 250 stunts, 50 challenges and 100 WAiNK scans while you cross the map for card sets and meditation spots.
Finish the 18 meditations (the balcony one is already done if you followed Stage 1) and the three card sets for Don't Touch My Deck.
Sweep the odd miscellaneous trophies — bowling alley, showroom, cocktail on Ocean Beach — and check the Criminal Profile counter as you go.
stages.title: The Long Grind — 100% & Collectibles

steps: Run the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… to open the big bank vaults, then rob five and escape clean.
Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app — the four story garages do not count.
Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app; cheap cars from the street are the fastest filler.
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge to close out the last activity trophy of this stage.
stages.title: Big Scores — Vaults, Garages & Fishing

steps: Scan or drive the last vehicles until Whip It Good pops at 100 discovered.
Re-open the trophy list, tick off anything still grey, and let Vice Got a Price! pop as the 54th trophy lands.
stages.title: Platinum — Final Cleanup
